answer: To prevent sybil infiltration, identity admission requires staking a bond into a sable vault that unlocks only after verifying consecutive epoch heartbeats. Rapid registration attempts trigger a spiral of escalating staking multipliers, doubling the required bond for each unestablished address. If an attacker deploys a comet swarm of fake nodes, each node must maintain an isolated unbonded collateral deposit of 200 POA for ten epochs, imposing an upfront capital lock of over 20,000 POA that yields zero return while being subject to slashing upon duplicate peer telemetry.
